Pull Apart Garlic Bread  Ingredients * 1 tsp yeast * 1 tbsp sugar * 270g milk (about 1 cup + 2 tbsp) * 380g flour (about 3 cups) * 1 tsp salt * 43g softened butter (about 3 tbsp) Butter Mixture * 100g butter, softened * 1 tbsp chopped cilantro * 1 garlic clove, minced * Shredded cheese Instructions 1. In a bowl, mix the sugar and yeast. Add the milk, then add the flour and mix until combined. 2. Add the salt and softened butter, then coil fold until the butter is fully incorporated. 3. Cover and let the dough rest for 2 hours or until doubled. 4. Mix the softened butter with the cilantro and minced garlic. 5. Roll the dough into a rectangle and spread the garlic butter mixture evenly over it. Sprinkle with shredded cheddar cheese. 6. Cut the dough in half, stack one half on top of the other, then cut into strips. Transfer the pieces into a loaf pan. 7. Cover and let rest for 20 minutes. 8. Bake at 370°F for 30 minutes, or until golden brown. 9. Brush with the remaining garlic butter mixture while still warm. #bread #garlicbread #breadtok #baking #homemadebread

Ingredients: 1 tbsp salted butter 1 can (14oz)sweetened condensed milk  2/3 cup sweetened coconut flakes  Sugar coating: 1 cup granulated sugar 1/2 cup water 1 tbsp vinegar  How to: In a sauce pan add butter and turn it on medium heat until melted. Next add in sweetened condensed milk and coconut flakes. Stir on medium heat for 5-7 minutes until the mixture is thickened and can pull away from the pan. Add it into a separate bowl and place in the refrigerator until cooled.  Once cooled, take a tbsp of the mixture and roll it between greased hands to form a ball and place it onto a parchment lined pan until all of the mixture is formed into bite sized balls. Next in a sauce, pan, combine sugar, water, and vinegar. Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally, until it turns amber in color. Take off the heat. Next insert a toothpick into each ball and dip it into the amber sugar and place back onto a parchment lined pan.  Let cool and serve! #dessert #coconut #balabaiana #easyrecipe #recipeshare

Steak Cheese and Rice is easy to make and never disappoints! 🌮 INGREDIENTS  1 1/2 lbs Sirloin or New York Strip steak, sliced thin  1/2 tsp each salt and pepper 1 tsp each cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder 2 tsp chili powder 2 cups Jasmine rice rinsed  2 tbsp olive oil divided  1 small onion chopped 3 cups chicken broth 1 tbsp tomato Bouillon  1 1/2 cups White Queso 1 tbsp Fresh Cilantro 1 package Fajita size flour tortillas INSTRUCTIONS  Slice 1 1/2 lbs of steak into thin pieces. Add your sliced steak to a bowl with 1 tbsp olive oil. Season with salt, pepper, cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder, and chili powder. Stir until steak is well coated in seasoning and oil. Set aside.   Rinse 2 cups of Jasmine rice. Add rice to a skillet over medium-high heat. Add 1 tbsp of olive oil and stir the rice around the skillet letting it toast up for 4-5 minutes.  Add the chopped onion and tomato bouillon to the skillet. Stir well. Add 3 cups of chicken broth. Stir well and let cook until it starts bubbling.  Once the whole skillet is bubbling, cover with a lid, lower the heat to medium low, and let cook for about 18 minutes or until rice is tender.   While the rice is cooking, heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the steak until it is cooked to your liking. I cooked the steak for about 10 minutes. Remove it from the heat.  Top the cooked rice with the steak and pour white queso over the skillet of steak and rice. Top with fresh cilantro. Serve as is or inside of flour tortillas.  #easyrecipes #dinner #steak

Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wraps🍗🧀🌯 The flavours are absolutely phenomenal, one of the best wraps made using a sheet pan. Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Crispy Rice Paper Burger 🍔  2 sheets rice paper 1 egg, whisked 1 cooked beef burger patty 2 slices smoked cheese 1 tbsp burger sauce 2–3 sweet & spicy pickle slices 2–3 large cos lettuce leaves Method 1. Dip both sheets of rice paper into the whisked egg until completely coated, then stack them on top of each other. 2. Press the stacked rice paper into a small bowl to create a cup shape. 3. Layer in 1 slice of smoked cheese, the cooked burger patty, burger sauce, sweet & spicy pickles and the remaining slice of smoked cheese. 4. Fold the edges of the rice paper over the filling, pressing them down to enclose the burger. 5. Carefully flip the parcel out of the bowl and place seam-side down in the air fryer basket. 6. Air fry at 190°C for 8–10 minutes, flipping halfway, until deeply golden and crispy. Keep an eye on it towards the end as rice paper can brown quickly. 7. Wrap the crispy burger in cos lettuce and serve immediately. #dinner #recipe #burger

Quick and easy cinnamon roll bites 😮‍💨😋 Ingredients: Pillsbury Grands biscuits  ⅓ cup unsalted butter, melted ⅓ cup granulated sugar ½ tablespoon ground cinnamon 1½ cups powdered sugar ⅓ cup heavy whipping cream ½ tablespoon vanilla bean paste or extract Instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Using a 16.3-ounce can of Pillsbury Grands biscuits, cut each biscuit into quarters and gently roll each piece into a ball. Transfer the biscuit pieces to a mixing bowl. Add the melted butter and cinnamon sugar, then gently toss until each piece is evenly coated. Lightly spray a 9x9-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray or coat it with a thin layer of butter. Transfer the coated biscuit pieces to the baking dish and spread them out evenly. Bake at 350°F for 25–28 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. While the cinnamon roll bites are baking, prepare the icing. In a bowl, whisk together 1½ cups of powdered sugar, ⅓ cup of heavy whipping cream, and about ½ tablespoon of vanilla bean paste or vanilla extract. For a thicker icing, add more powdered sugar. For a thinner consistency, add a little more heavy whipping cream. Let the cinnamon roll bites cool for about 5 minutes before drizzling or spreading the icing over the top. 30-Minute Garlic Butter Steak Bites & Potatoes 🥩🥔🧄 If you need a quick and easy dinner idea, you have to try these garlic butter steak bites and potatoes! The potatoes are perfectly seasoned and crispy, and the steak is juicy, tender, and tossed in the most delicious garlic butter. And the best part? You can have dinner on the table in about 30 minutes! 🤤 RECIPE BELOW ⬇️  Potatoes: * 4 russet potatoes, diced * 2 tbsp olive oil * 1 tsp each: salt, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika & Italian seasoning * ½ tsp black pepper Steak: * 1½ lbs sirloin tip steak, cubed * 1 tsp olive oil * 1–2 tsp Montreal steak seasoning * 1 tbsp oil for cooking * 2 tbsp butter * 3 cloves garlic, minced * Fresh parsley Instructions 👩🏽‍🍳 1. Wash, peel, and dice your potatoes. Toss with olive oil and seasonings. Salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Italian seasoning. Y’all know I don’t measure. I just season until my ancestors tell me to stop! 😂 2. Air fry at 400°F for 20–25 minutes, shaking halfway through, until crispy. You can also bake at 425°F for 25–30 minutes or pan-fry! 3. While those cook, cut your steak into bite-sized pieces and toss with a little olive oil and steak seasoning. I used Montreal, but use your favorite! 4. Get your skillet nice and hot! Add a little oil and sear steak for about 2 minutes per side until browned. Cast iron works best, but any skillet will do! 5. Reduce heat, scoot steak to the edges, and add butter and garlic. Cook for 30–60 seconds until fragrant, then toss everything in that garlic butter. 6. Turn off the heat, add your crispy potatoes, gently mix, and top with fresh parsley! Serve with cheesy rice, mac and cheese, asparagus, or whatever your heart desires! ❤️ Save this for your next easy weeknight dinner! 🔖 #GarlicButterSteakBites #SteakAndPotatoes #30MinuteMeals #EasyDinnerIdeas #WeeknightDinners

Arsenio’s Chipotle Mac n Cheese Balls 🧀 Recipe👇🏽 Ingredients ½ lb (227 g) cavatappi pasta ¼ cup (57 g) butter ⅓ cup (40–45 g) all-purpose flour 1½ cups (360 ml) milk 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp paprika ½ tsp black pepper ¼ chicken bouillon cube, grated 1 tbsp chipotle pepper sauce 1 cup (100 g) shredded marble cheese 1 cup (100 g) shredded mozzarella 1 cup (100 g) extra shredded mozzarella for binding Salt to taste, if needed 2 eggs, beaten Panko breadcrumbs Oil for frying Instructions Cook the cavatappi in salted water until al dente, then drain well. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the garlic powder, paprika and black pepper, then stir in the flour. Cook for 1–2 minutes, stirring constantly. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth. Keep stirring until the sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. Add the grated chicken bouillon and chipotle pepper sauce. Turn off the heat, add the marble cheese and mozzarella, and stir until melted. Taste and add salt if needed. Mix the cooked pasta into the cheese sauce until everything is coated. Add the extra 1 cup of shredded mozzarella and mix until combined. Scoop portions onto pieces of parchment paper. Wrap the parchment around each portion and twist the ends to form tight balls. Place on a tray and freeze for about 1 hour, or until firm. Dip each ball into the beaten eggs, then coat generously in panko breadcrumbs. Heat the oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry until golden and crispy, making sure the centres are heated through. Larger balls may need extra time, so test one first. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. Let them cool slightly, break one open and enjoy that cheesy centre. I hope it crunches! ❤️

Lasagna (No Pasta Noodles!) 🧅 A little twist on traditional lasagna! Instead of pasta noodles, we’re using tender onion layers, savory meat sauce, and a creamy Boursin cheese filling. I wasn’t sure how this would turn out, but it was SO good! Ingredients Onion layers * 3 large yellow onions Meat sauce * 1 lb lean ground beef * 3–4 cloves garlic, minced * 2 tbsp tomato paste * 1 jar Yo Mamas Foods marinara sauce * 1 tsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp onion powder * ½ tsp smoked paprika * Salt and black pepper, to taste Creamy cheese filling * 1 (5.2 oz) package Boursin Garlic & Fine Herbs * ¼ cup plain Greek yogurt * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * ½ cup shredded mozzarella * 1 egg For layering * Additional shredded mozzarella * Parmesan cheese Instructions 1. Trim both ends of the onions and remove the outer skin. Boil the onions whole in a large pot of water for approximately 20–25 minutes, or until tender enough for the layers to separate easily without falling apart. 2. Drain and let the onions cool for about 30 minutes. Gently separate the layers. 3. Brown the ground beef in a skillet. Add minced garlic, tomato paste, marinara, and seasonings. Stir and let simmer until the sauce thickens. 4. In a bowl, mix Boursin, Greek yogurt, Parmesan, mozzarella, and egg until creamy. 5. In a baking dish, layer meat sauce, onion layers, creamy cheese filling, and mozzarella. Repeat until your dish is filled. 6. Finish with meat sauce, mozzarella, and Parmesan. 7. Bake uncovered at 375°F for 15–20 minutes, until hot and bubbly. Broil for 1–2 minutes if you’d like a golden cheese topping. 8. Let rest before slicing and serving. And that’s it! A fun little twist on lasagna that you have to try. 🤍 Save this recipe for your next dinner night! @Yo Mama's Foods @Boursin Cheese  #OnionLasagna #DinnerIdeas #LasagnaRecipe #HomeCooking #EasyDinner

VIRAL BROTHY BEEF BOWLS 🔥 If you love soup recipes, but want something substantial and super filling, these are one of the best easy weeknight meals. It’s so easy to make, so good, and packed with protei and flavor. These are super filling and come in under 500 calories and 35g protein a bowl. One of my favorite protein hacks is using a really good bone broth.That little Kettle & Fire carton has almost 20g of protein on its own, I used up a cup in the broth, and a cup making the rice instead of water to boost the protein + flavor. Here is how I made it: 1️⃣ Start with 1 lb ground beef in a large pan over medium-high heat. Break it apart as it browns, then add 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp red chili flakes, and a generous pinch of salt. Brown it up really well. 2️⃣ For the broth, add 2.5 tbsp red curry paste and 2 minced garlic cloves to a saucepan over medium heat. Stir for 1-2 mins until softened and fragrant. 3️⃣ Pour in 3/4 cup half-and-half (or coconut milk) and 1 cup Kettle & Fire bone broth. Stir everything together until smooth and bring to a gentle simmer. 4️⃣ Season the broth with a generous couple pinches salt, fresh lime juice, and freshly chopped cilantro. Taste and adjust to your liking. You want it creamy, savory, a little spicy, and bright from the lime. 5️⃣ For the quick pickled red onions, super thinly slice 1/2 large red onion and add it to a bowl. Add juice of 1 lemon and sprinkle with sea salt. Mix really well with a fork and let sit 5-10 mins to soften. 6️⃣ Prepare 4 servings rice of choice. I love replacing the water in mine with bone broth for extra flavor + protein. 7️⃣ To assemble, add 3/4 cup cooked rice to a bowl, add 1/4 of the seasoned beef, and ladle 1/4 of the broth over everything. 8️⃣ Top with thinly sliced cucumbers, quick pickled red onions, sesame seeds, Korean chili flakes and plenty of finely chopped fresh cilantro. If you make it, let me know what you think on SHREDHAPPENS! ENJOY! 🙌 #healthyrecipes #healthyfoodshare #goodmoodfood

LAZY CINNAMON ROLL APPLE PIE 🍏🥧✨ This recipe has gone viral every time I’ve shared it over the years, it’s one of those warm, cozy classics that makes its way onto our table every holiday. Perfect for Thanksgiving, family get-togethers, or an easy Christmas morning breakfast! You can even prep it the night before and pop it in the oven the next morning! 🎄 Ingredients 🍏  1 can refrigerated cinnamon rolls (with icing) 1 can apple pie filling (21 oz) ¼ cup heavy cream 4 tbsp melted butter ½ cup brown sugar ½ cup all-purpose flour ½ tsp cinnamon DIRECTIONS🥧 1. Preheat your oven to 350°F. Pour the heavy cream into the bottom of a greased pie dish or baking dish. 2. Cut your cinnamon rolls into quarters and spread them evenly over the heavy cream. Spoon the apple pie filling right on top. 3. In a bowl, mix the melted butter, brown sugar, flour, and cinnamon until you get a crumbly, wet sand texture. Sprinkle evenly over the apples. 4. Bake for 30–35 minutes, or until golden brown and the cinnamon rolls are cooked through. Let cool slightly before drizzling with the icing from the cinnamon roll package! Serve warm with vanilla ice cream if you want to make it extra delicious! 🤎 TIP: You can use homemade apple pie filling or swap in your favorite canned pie filling! To prep ahead, assemble everything, cover, and refrigerate overnight, then bake fresh in the morning. YALL COME EAT it’s my viral sausage tortellini. 🤤  This recipe has nearly 5 million views on TikTok, so I thought it was time for an official step-by-step.  1. Cook 1 bag of tortellini according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. 2. Add 2 packs of sliced andouille sausage and cook until browned and heated through. Remove the sausage and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add 1 small finely chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3–4 minutes. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 4. Add 8–10 halved cherry tomatoes, 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes and 1 tablespoon tomato paste. Stir everything together and cook for 2–3 minutes. 5. Season with 1 teaspoon oregano, 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon parsley, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder and 1 teaspoon onion powder. Add salt and pepper to taste. 6. Pour in 1 cup heavy cream and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, then add ½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese. Stir until the Parmesan melts and the sauce becomes creamy. 7. Add 1 cup roughly chopped spinach and stir until wilted. 8. Add the cooked tortellini and browned andouille sausage back into the skillet. Toss everything together until the tortellini and sausage are completely coated in the creamy sauce. Cook for another 1–2 minutes. 9. Garnish with red chili flakes and additional Parmesan cheese, if desired. #viralrecipe #tortellini #easydinnerideas #pastarecipe #familymeal

This recipe went VIRAL for a reason… and I’m convinced it’s the BEST Sunday dinner you’ll ever make! 🤤👏🏼 I’ve made these slow-roasted chicken thighs for 9 Sundays in a row, and my family STILL isn’t tired of them! 😂 Perfectly seasoned, melt-in-your-mouth tender, and packed with SO much flavor! It’s one of those meals that looks impressive but is ridiculously easy to make! Ingredients: • Boneless chicken thighs • Salt & pepper • Garlic powder • Paprika • Italian seasoning • Olive oil • 1 sliced onion (I use less!) • 2 cups chicken broth • Fresh thyme • Cornstarch + cold water (for gravy) Directions: 1. Place chicken thighs in a baking dish and generously season both sides with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika & Italian seasoning. 2. Drizzle with olive oil and add sliced onions. 3. Pour in 2 cups of chicken broth and add fresh thyme. 4. Cover and bake at 350°F for 1 hour. 5. Remove thyme and pour the cooking liquid into a separate bowl. Mix cornstarch with cold water to make a slurry, then stir into the liquid. 6. Pour the gravy mixture back over the chicken. 7. Bake UNCOVERED at 450°F for another 30 minutes, until the chicken is beautifully browned and the gravy thickens!  And YES, I promise the broth doesn’t wash off all that seasoning. 😂 Just trust the process! Viral Chewy Potatoes with Spicy Orange Glaze 🥔🍊 Prep Time: 15 mins | Cook Time: 20 mins | Servings: 2-3 INGREDIENTS Potato Base 2-3 medium gold potatoes (peeled and roughly chopped) 1/2 cup + 1 tbsp water 3/4 cup tapioca starch 1/2 tsp salt Neutral oil for deep frying Spicy Orange Glaze 1/4 cup orange juice, freshly squeezed 1 tsp orange zest 2 tbsp gochujang (Korean chili paste) 1 tbsp honey or brown sugar 1 tbsp soy sauce 1 clove garlic, minced 1 tsp grated fresh ginger 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes or cayenne pepper (optional) 1 tsp sesame oil Garnish Fresh parsley, finely chopped INSTRUCTIONS 1. Place peeled and chopped gold potatoes and water into a blender. Blend on high until completely smooth with zero lumps. 2. Pour the blended potato mixture into a microwave-safe bowl. Microwave in 30-to-45-second intervals, stirring in between, for about 4–5 minutes total until it turns into a thick, glossy, sticky paste. 3. Stir salt and tapioca starch directly into the hot potato paste. Knead until a smooth, stretchy dough forms. Transfer the warm dough into a piping bag or a sturdy zip-top bag with a bottom corner snipped off. 4. In a small bowl, whisk together orange juice, orange zest, gochujang, honey, soy sauce, minced garlic, ginger, and red pepper flakes. Pour into a small saucepan over medium heat and simmer for 3–4 minutes until it reduces into a sticky, bright orange glaze. Turn off the heat and stir in sesame oil. Set aside. 5. Heat 2 inches of neutral oil in a deep pan to 325°F (165°C). Pipe short strands of potato dough directly into the hot oil, using kitchen scissors to snip them off. Fry in small batches for 2–3 minutes until puffed, cooked through, and very pale golden. Drain on a wire rack or paper towels for at least 5 minutes. 6. Increase the oil temperature to 375°F (190°C). Return the par-fried potatoes to the oil in small batches and fry for 1–2 minutes until deeply golden brown and extra crispy on the outside. Drain briefly. 7. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately alongside the spicy orange glaze for dipping. #recipe #cooking #asmr #foodtok

🍫 Knock Me Naked Cake A rich, chocolatey Butterfinger poke cake loaded with sweetened condensed milk, Cool Whip, and caramel! Ingredients 1 box Duncan Hines Devil’s Food Cake Mix 4 eggs 1 cup milk 1 stick butter, melted 1 can sweetened condensed milk 1 bag fun-size Butterfinger candy bars, crushed 2 containers Cool Whip Caramel sauce, for drizzling Instructions 1. Prepare the cake: Preheat your oven to 350°F. Mix together the cake mix, eggs, milk, and melted butter until well combined. Pour into a greased 9×13-inch baking dish. 2. Bake: Bake for 29–30 minutes, depending on your oven, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. 3. Poke & pour: While the cake is still warm, poke holes all over the top. Pour the entire can of sweetened condensed milk evenly over the cake, allowing it to soak into the holes. 4. Add the Butterfingers: Crush the entire bag of fun-size Butterfinger candy bars. Sprinkle half of the crushed candy over the cake and save the remaining half for topping. 5. Cool completely: Allow the cake to cool completely before adding the topping. 6. Finish it off: Spread both containers of Cool Whip evenly over the cake. Sprinkle the remaining crushed Butterfingers on top and finish with a generous drizzle of caramel sauce. 7. Refrigerate & serve: Cover and store the cake in the refrigerator until ready to serve. Keep any leftovers refrigerated. 🤎 Kalyn’s Tip: This cake is delicious served cold! Give it time to chill so all that sweetened condensed milk can soak into the chocolate cake. #KnockMeNakedCake #ButterfingerCake #PokeCake #SouthernDesserts #EasyDessert

Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

Coming very soon, so follow my page so you don’t miss it Ingredients • 5 lb Yukon gold potatoes • 16 oz cream cheese, softened • ⅓ cup sour cream • ½ cup milk • 1 stick butter, softened, plus extra slices for topping • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tsp salt • Paprika, for topping • 1 bunch fresh chives, chopped Instructions 1. Set out the cream cheese and butter to soften. Preheat the oven to 400°F. 2. Boiling Method: Peel the potatoes and cut into evenly sized chunks. Place in a large pot, cover with cold water, and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer and cook for 15–20 minutes, or until fork-tender. 3. Instant Pot Method (Alternative): Add 1 cup of water to the Instant Pot and place the trivet inside. Add the whole, unpeeled potatoes. Pressure cook on high for 14 minutes, then allow a 10-minute natural pressure release before releasing the remaining pressure. Carefully remove, cool slightly, and peel. Cook in batches if necessary. 4. Transfer cooked potatoes to a large mixing bowl. Add cream cheese, sour cream, milk, butter, salt, and pepper. 5. Use a hand mixer or stand mixer to mix until smooth and creamy, being careful not to overmix. 6. Transfer to a greased 9×13-inch baking dish and spread evenly. 7. Sprinkle paprika over the top and add a few thin slices of butter. 8. Cover tightly with aluminum foil. 9. Bake at 400°F for 60 minutes, or until heated through. 10. Remove the foil during the final 5 minutes to lightly brown the top. 11. Sprinkle the freshly chopped chives over the top before serving. Make-Ahead Instructions 1. Prepare the mashed potatoes following steps 1–8 above, using either cooking method. Wait to preheat the oven until you’re ready to bake. 2. Cover tightly with foil and refrigerate for up to 2 days. 3. Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before baking. 4. Preheat oven to 400°F. 5. Bake covered for approximately 60 minutes, until hot in the center. 6. Remove foil for the final 5 minutes to lightly brown the top. 7. Sprinkle with the chopped chives before serving. #mashedpotatoes #EasyRecipe

One stick of butter, a handful of simple ingredients, and a whole house filled with the smell of love. 🧈✨ This is my grandmother's Stick of Butter Chicken and Rice… the kind of easy chicken and rice casserole that simmers with memory and makes you feel held before the first bite. Chicken thighs baked over rice with French onion soup, beef consommé, mushrooms, Parmesan, and a whole stick of butter. It tastes like legacy and everything good. One dish, minimal prep, and a homemade family dinner that feels like a hug. 🤍 INGREDIENTS: 2 cups white rice 1 (10.5-oz) can condensed French onion soup 2 (10.5-oz) cans condensed beef consommé 8 oz baby portobello mushrooms, roughly chopped 1 cup grated Pecorino Romano or Parmesan, divided 1 stick salted butter, cut into 8 pieces 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Seasoning 1¼ tsp kosher salt ¾ tsp freshly ground black pepper 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp paprika To finish (optional) 1 tbsp chopped fresh parsley DIRECTIONS: 1. Preheat the oven to 350°F. 2. In a 9×13 baking dish, stir together the rice, French onion soup, beef consommé, and chopped mushrooms. Spread everything into an even layer. 3. Sprinkle ¾ cup of the cheese over the rice mixture, then dot the top with the pieces of butter. 4. Season the chicken thighs evenly with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika. Arrange the chicken on top of the rice mixture. 5. Sprinkle the remaining cheese over the chicken, then cover the dish tightly with foil. 6. Bake for 45 minutes. 7. Remove the foil and continue baking for about 20 minutes, until the top is golden, the rice has absorbed the liquid, and the chicken is cooked through and tender. 8. Let it rest for a few minutes, then finish with fresh parsley if you like. #StickOfButterChickenAndRice #ChickenAndRiceCasserole #ComfortFoodRecipes #EasyDinnerIdeas #FamilyRecipe
